title: Quiet Endermen
description: Reduces all Endermen volume by 36 dB
body:
Endermen XP farms are really popular, and for good reason. However they're really loud.
This resource pack allows you to not have to manually reduce the hostile mob volume everytime you enter/exit your farm.

Plus Endermen are really loud during regular gameplay, this will help with that.

If you validate the pack with any other version, feel free to comment and I'll add a version on the downloads.
